items.stem: What is the primary job of a board paper?

options.text: To enable a specific decision by the board
options.rationale: Correct: a board paper exists to support a decision, not merely to inform.

options.text: To record every operational detail of a programme
options.rationale: Exhaustive detail belongs elsewhere; the board needs the decision.

options.text: To demonstrate how much work the team did
options.rationale: Effort is not the purpose of a board paper.

options.text: To summarise the last meeting's minutes

items.explanation: Correct: a board paper exists to support a decision, not merely to inform.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO belong in a well-structured recommendation section? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: the board needs an explicit recommendation.

options.text: The rationale linking evidence to the recommendation
options.rationale: Correct: a recommendation needs its reasoning to be defensible.

options.text: A list of options with no stated preference
options.rationale: Leaving the board to guess is not a recommendation.
Hiding risks undermines a defensible recommendation.

items.explanation: Correct: the board needs an explicit recommendation.

items.stem: You plan to draft a board paper containing unreleased financial results with Claude. What must you check first?

options.text: Your organisation's data-handling and confidentiality settings for the workspace
options.rationale: Correct: confidential material requires confirming retention and sharing settings first.

options.text: Whether the paper uses the latest font
options.rationale: Typography is not a confidentiality control.

options.text: The length of the chat history
options.rationale: Chat length is irrelevant to confidentiality.

options.text: Nothing; results are safe to paste anywhere
options.rationale: Unreleased results are highly sensitive and must be handled carefully.

items.explanation: Correct: confidential material requires confirming retention and sharing settings first.
